WITH stock AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_value, f.closing_units
 FROM fact_stock_week f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22'),
wk AS (
 SELECT p.category, st.week_ending_date, sum(st.closing_value) v, count(*) n, count(p.product_key) matched,
   sum(abs(st.closing_value - st.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)) costdiff
 FROM stock st LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=st.product_key
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT category, count(*) weeks, sum(n) nrows, sum(matched) matched, round(avg(v),2) avg_weekly_value, round(sum(costdiff),2) costdiff
FROM wk GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH stock AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_value, f.closing_units
 FROM fact_stock_week f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22'),
wk AS (
 SELECT p.category AS category, st.week_ending_date AS wk_end, sum(st.closing_value) AS v, count(*) AS n, count(p.product_key) AS n_matched,
   sum(abs(st.closing_value - st.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)) AS costdiff
 FROM stock st LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=st.product_key
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT category, count(*) AS n_weeks, sum(n) AS n_rows, sum(n_matched) AS n_matched, round(avg(v),2) AS avg_weekly_value, round(sum(costdiff),2) AS costdiff
FROM wk GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
